subject: How an occupied insert slot differs from an empty one in the channel strip
question: Can an insert slot's occupancy and its plug-in be read, and by which attribute?

reverify.command: Open a project with a plug-in on at least one insert. Walk the arrange window to depth 10 collecting role, description, help and position for every element whose description names the plug-in or whose help begins with the audio-effect-slot string. Compare an occupied row against an empty one on the same strip.
reverify.expected: occupied reads AXGroup with the plug-in name as its description and no help; empty reads AXButton with a generic description and the slot help
reverify.cost: ~3 min with a project open; read-only

method: Enumerated without narrowing the role first. An earlier pass filtered on the slot help string, found every match identical, and would have supported the opposite conclusion -- the occupied slots were not AXButtons and carry no help, so a help filter cannot see them at all.

observations.what: one strip, four insert rows, top to bottom

rows.help: 오디오 이펙트 슬롯. 오디오 이펙트를 삽입합니다…
오디오 이펙트 슬롯. 오디오 이펙트를 삽입합니다…

observations.what: the neighbour that also carries the plug-in name
observations.help: 라이브러리 포커스 삼각형. 강조 표시된 슬롯의…
observations.position_relative_to_the_slot: same row, to the left (x 366 against 389)

observations.what: an earlier pass that aimed only at the slot help
observations.note: the fixture had two plug-ins inserted at the time

observations.what: what the product reports for the same track

conclusion: Occupancy changes the element, not a property of it. An empty insert is an AXButton described 오디오 플러그인 and carrying the audio-effect-slot help; an occupied one is an AXGroup described with the plug-in name and carrying no help at all. So help identifies an empty slot and cannot identify a full one, and a reader that filters by the slot help string sees only the empty slots -- an earlier pass here matched 17 of them, every one an AXButton, while two plug-ins were inserted. Description identifies a full slot, but not alone: the library focus triangle sits in the same row and is described 라이브러리 표시기, Compressor, so a description containing the plug-in name is satisfied by the neighbour too. Role plus description together separate all four cases. The product's own get_inventory already reports this correctly.
limits: One plug-in (Compressor), one project, ko-KR. Whether every plug-in's occupied slot is an AXGroup, or whether some expose help, was not measured.
Bypassed and disabled slots were not exercised; only occupied and empty.
This is a reading of the surface, not of any write path. Nothing here says an insert can be set or cleared.
The strips were read where they were rendered; no attempt was made to distinguish the Inspector strip from Mixer strips, so the row counts are per rendered strip rather than per track.
